text: about the company northstar digital is a fictional technology company building practical software products and data - driven tools for business teams. our engineering group values curiosity, clear communication, thoughtful problem - solving, and maintainable code. role overview we are looking for a junior python developer to help build, test, and maintain python - based applications and services. this role is suitable for a recent graduate or an early - career developer who has a solid programming foundation and is eager to grow through hands - on work with experienced engineers. key responsibilities write clean, readable, and reusable python code for application features and internal tools. assist in building and maintaining rest api endpoints and integrating third - party services. work with relational databases to write queries and manage application data. debug issues, write basic tests, and participate in code reviews. collaborate with product, design, and engineering teammates to clarify requirements and deliver tasks. document technical decisions, setup instructions, and implementation details. required qualifications bachelor ’ s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field ; equivalent practical experience is welcome. working knowledge of python fundamentals, including functions, collections, modules, and exception handling. understanding of object - oriented programming and basic data structures. basic sql knowledge and familiarity with relational databases such as mysql or postgresql. understanding of http and rest api concepts. ability to use git for basic version control and explain code written in personal or academic projects. preferred qualifications exposure to flask, fastapi, or django. familiarity with pandas or numpy and handling csv / json data. experience writing unit tests or using an api testing tool. a github portfolio containing coursework, personal projects, or contributions. what success looks like delivers small, well - scoped python tasks with guidance and communicates blockers early. produces code that is understandable, tested, and consistent with team conventions. shows steady progress in api development, database use,
